utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Sam. I’m still short on hands for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m in for Saturday on the front porch. Tell me what you want me to handle, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik. I really appreciate you spreading the word, and I’m glad to have you helping pull together a few more neighbors for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’m still in for Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll keep spreading the word to a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what time should I come by on Saturday, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mina — could you come by around 9 a.m. with work gloves if you have them? I’ll have the rest ready on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I could use help setting up the front porch this Saturday. If you can come a little early, I’ll need someone to keep the space organized and help things move along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can come early and help keep the porch organized. Just point me where you need me, and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch — I can help out if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Oren — I could definitely use another helper this Saturday on the front porch. Let me know what part you’d like to take on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — that helps. I’m keeping the front porch setup for Saturday, and I’ll let you know the exact tasks once I’ve got the space sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, just keep me posted on the tasks once the porch is sorted, and I’ll line up a few more helpers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you still need help setting up the front porch repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I still do. If you’re free, I’d really appreciate a hand with setup on Saturday.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
